source.note: known-divergences/click-reserved-word.md, The difference: this `click` does not start a click statement, so this specification rejects the input, which mermaid.js accepts; leaving out the `click`, the space after it, and the space that leaves the click context joins `me` and the `accDescr` of the empty description block before the line break, so nothing follows for the reference input, which mermaid.js rejects.
